summary: SQLx-backed Postgres command executor adapter seam for backbone persistence execution plans.
claim_boundary: Adapter seam only. This slice adds a compiling SQLx Postgres batch executor that validates generated SqlExecutionPlan values, opens a transaction, applies tenant scope through set_config, executes parameterized statements, commits, and returns SqlExecutionReport metadata. Unit tests cover validation and strict TLS database-url shape. No live Postgres/Citus cluster, RLS assertion, migration runner, backup/restore drill, Citus rebalance drill, or production database SLO evidence is claimed.
source_basis: cargo info sqlx@0.8.6 --verbose confirmed the selected sqlx 0.8.6 crate and postgres/runtime-tokio-rustls feature surface available to the adapter.

Local sqlx-postgres 0.8.6 source/docs confirmed PgSslMode defaults to Prefer and may fall back to non-SSL, so the adapter requires explicit sslmode=require, sslmode=verify-ca, or sslmode=verify-full when pool config requires TLS.
Local cargo-deny 0.19.6 configuration template/source confirmed per-crate license exceptions use exact crate specs under licenses.exceptions.

facets.F1_simplicity: The live execution seam is isolated in a single adapter crate over the existing oya-shared-postgres-command-kernel plan/report types instead of coupling domain/usecase crates directly to SQLx.
facets.F2_hyperscaler: The executor preserves tenant, audit, policy, idempotency, and plan-hash metadata from deterministic repository command plans while leaving live Citus/RLS/backup drills as explicit follow-up work.
facets.F3_adversarial: Tests reject unsafe SQL shapes, tenant-scope command drift, empty batches, placeholder/parameter mismatches, and non-strict TLS database URL shapes including missing sslmode, disable, allow, and prefer.
facets.F5_quality: Focused adapter tests plus the 35-package backbone check/test/clippy/fmt matrix, cargo-deny, dependency-seam, honest-claims, workflow/catalog JSON/YAML parsing, and diff hygiene are part of this run.
facets.F7_security_privacy: The adapter uses SQLx parameter binding rather than interpolating values, validates statement shape before transaction execution, requires explicit strict TLS database URL modes by default, and records metadata without logging statement parameter values.
facets.F11_observability: SqlExecutionReport records tenant, audit reference, idempotency key, plan hash, command count, affected rows, and per-statement refs for future runtime telemetry correlation.
